title: Poisoning the corpora of protein design systems during pre-training and retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.21200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein foundation models increasingly support the generation of novel biological sequences, yet their reliance on large public datasets creates opportunities for adversarial manipulation of the material they learn from and retrieve. We investigate two data-only poisoning attacks against protein design systems, targeting the pre-training corpus of autoregressive protein language models and the retrieval corpus of a text-guided protein generator. For the first, we pre-trained ProtGPT2 and ProGen2 variants of 300 million parameters, introducing poisoned protein sequences containing one of two triggers followed by one of three payloads. Across all poisoned runs, both architectures acquired highly reliable trigger-dependent generation under uniform and ramped poisoning schedules. translated_title: 在预训练和检索阶段对蛋白质设计系统语料库的投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 蛋白质基础模型日益支持新型生物序列的生成，然而其对大型公共数据集的依赖为其所学习和检索的材料遭受对抗性操纵创造了机会。我们研究了针对蛋白质设计系统的两种纯数据投毒攻击，分别针对自回归蛋白质语言模型的预训练语料库和文本引导蛋白质生成器的检索语料库。对于第一种攻击，我们预训练了参数量为3亿的ProtGPT2和ProGen2变体，引入了包含两种触发器之一、后接三种有效载荷之一的投毒蛋白质序列。在所有投毒运行中，两种架构在均匀和递增投毒计划下均获得了高度可靠的触发器依赖生成能力。在递增暴露方式下，最早的多数激活仅出现在200个污染样本之后，而在均匀计划下，最早激活发生于……
tldr: 本研究首次证明，仅需在蛋白质语言模型的预训练语料库或文本引导蛋白质生成器的检索语料库中注入少量（低至200条）含触发器的投毒序列，即可使模型产生攻击者可控的特定序列生成行为，揭示了蛋白质设计AI系统面临的严重数据安全威胁。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that data-only poisoning attacks—injecting as few as 200 trigger-containing malicious protein sequences into pre-training or retrieval corpora—can reliably force protein design models like ProtGPT2 and ProGen2 to generate attacker-controlled sequences, exposing critical data security vulnerabilities in protein AI systems.
